summary: A native renderer may satisfy CSSOM/layout rules only when it exposes CSS parsing, cascade, box/layout and metric semantics compatible with the declared profile.

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.fallback: unsupported CSS/features escape to runtime rather than approximation

tests.name: normal
tests.expected_behavior: native renderer helper may answer CSSOM-compatible style/metric operation

tests.name: edge
tests.expected_behavior: must fall back instead of silently approximating browser behavior
